BLOCKED_BY_DEPENDENCY: classify_driver_failure's VM arm cannot satisfy S-VM-33/34/36/41 within this step's declared scope (action_shim/mod.rs + transition_reason.rs only; vm_driver.rs and overdrive-host/src/vmm.rs are out of scope). Traced the full call chain before authoring RED: (1) VmHostLayout.kernel is validated ONCE at overdrive serve boot in compose_vm_driver (lib.rs ~1720-1729); a boot-time kernel ENOENT or bad-format BOTH collapse unconditionally to VmComposeError::NotAvailable, so neither ever reaches a per-allocation Failed row -- the only way to reach Failed/VmKernelNotFound or Failed/VmKernelFormatUnsupported is a TOCTOU construction (valid kernel at boot, corrupted or deleted before this allocation's Vmm::create), mirroring S-VM-35's own TOCTOU framing. (2) That TOCTOU is only observable via VmDriver::start's async VmmExited race arm (vm_driver.rs ~613-622), which discards the resolved VmmExit entirely (the ended binding is underscore-prefixed and unused) and returns the hardcoded literal string 'VMM exited before the guest signalled ready' with zero interpolation of CH's own stderr, exit code, or signal -- so S-VM-33 (kernel not found), S-VM-37 (unclassified), and S-VM-41 (kernel format, CH's own misleading UefiTooBig text) are structurally indistinguishable given classify_driver_failure's text-only signature. (3) provision_vmm's rootfs pre-check (vm_driver.rs ~409-415) builds its reason text from a bare std::io::Error whose Display never carries the path, so VmRootfsNotFound.path cannot be populated from text alone. (4) BootRaceOutcome::Deadline's text (vm_driver.rs ~623-634) carries no console output at all, so VmBootDeadlineExceeded.console_tail cannot be derived from it (None is at least type-valid there). KernelImage::validate is a pure function requiring freshly-read header bytes that classify_driver_failure has no access to. Needs an architect decision on how vm_driver.rs (and possibly overdrive-host/src/vmm.rs) threads VmmExit.stderr_tail, the rootfs master path, and a console-log read into StartRejected.reason before RED/GREEN can proceed. See step report for full trace.
